channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLpolitics, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: States renew challenge to Trump's mail-in voting rule
item.description: A coalition of states is again trying to block President Trump's sweeping Postal Service rule on mail-in voting, days after the Supreme Court allowed it to take effect.

item.title: Waymo says no AI shortcut to self-driving cars
item.description: AI advances raise hopes for faster self-driving development, but Waymo, after 15 years, says there's no shortcut.

item.title: Judge lifts nationwide block on Trump's mail voting order
item.description: A federal judge lifted the nationwide block on Trump's mail-in voting policy after the Supreme Court cleared the way.

item.title: Meta settles with states, sets new industry standards over child safety
item.description: Meta agreed to a landmark $16.7 billion settlement with U.S. states over allegations that Facebook and Instagram were designed to harm children.
